verdicts.note: Income tax is authorised by the Sixteenth Amendment and statute; courts reject this as frivolous.
The court found no basis for the contention that the plaintiff need not pay (state property) taxes because he is a sovereign Moor; it does not address federal income tax.
The 16th Amendment authorizes a non-apportioned income tax on US citizens; the Supreme Court upheld it in Brushaber and courts have consistently rejected challenges.

Detaxer claims that the Income Tax Act is void, ultra vires or does not apply to natural persons were refused leave on a clear national question; a 1924 Privy Council ruling upholds federal income tax.
Australian courts rejected claims that income tax law was invalidly assented to, or could not be paid in paper money, many times over.
